verdict.rationale: A durable-execution platform with client APIs could reasonably publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and llms.txt is a documentation index rather than an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
